$comment: HARD CONSTRAINT. These paths are indexed and carry the site's only search equity. Do not rename, normalise or 'tidy' a slug here — /income-preservation-1 keeps its exact odd form on purpose.

redirectOnly.note: Preserved until 2026-08-16. The Wix path served the Services landing page rather than a blog index, which is why its live title was 'Resource | The Insurance Concierge'. The homepage copy deck moves Services to /services, so the equity 301s across to a topically identical page. The 12 posts it linked live at /single-post/... and are unaffected.

Preserved until 2026-08-16, then retired on the owner's instruction. The trailing -1 is a Wix artefact and is kept verbatim because that is the indexed form. 301 rather than 404: this was a functioning service page, not template junk like the store URLs, so its equity follows to the service index. That is a topical relationship, not the soft-404 pattern url-decisions.md warns about.

Preserved until 2026-08-16. NOT redirected to /services. The marine and oil and gas specialty product was dropped but its audience was not, so the search equity follows the audience. /offshore-and-energy is a new page and deliberately not the old copy renamed - it must never imply a separate marine policy.

dropped.$comment: Indexed on the Wix site but DELIBERATELY NOT preserved (decision 2026-08-11). These are an explicit, signed-off exception to the URL-preservation constraint - not an oversight. They must emit no artifact; `npm run verify:urls` enforces that. Do not re-add them because they appear in the old sitemap.

groups.reason: Wix store template that was enabled and never removed. Every product is placeholder demo content; preserving these URLs would carry 12 fake product pages onto the new site.
Unmodified Wix demo blog posts, not TIC content.

Wix-generated blog category index pages. Thin taxonomy pages with no original content; the posts they list are preserved individually. Note /blog appeared in the same child sitemap but is NOT dropped - since 2026-08-16 it is redirect-only, 301ing to /services.
Wix duplicate-page artefact ("copy of ..."), confirmed junk 2026-08-11. No original content and nothing to redirect to.

Wix quotation questionnaire form. Dropped by decision 2026-08-11. Unlike the other dropped groups this was a functioning page rather than template junk - if it ever carried quote-request traffic, a 301 to /forms or a contact page would preserve it. Deliberately not redirected.

Unfinished Wix template page, retired 2026-08-17 on the owner's instruction: "legacy and a mistake from the old site". The Wix original had an "Our Services" heading and the literal placeholder "I'm a title. Click here to edit me." Phase 2 rescued it by listing the service pages derived from primaryNav, which meant it re-listed the nav and nothing else; removing the footer sitemap then left it with no inbound link. It was briefly classified redirectOnly with a 301 to /services, on the assumption an indexed path is always worth preserving. It is not: there was never any original content to preserve, and render.yaml does not govern the live service, so that redirect would have been a rule nobody ever configured. Dropped, and it 404s deliberately.

Retired from the public site on 2026-08-17. The knowledge base, the forms library and every blog article moved into the CRM, so none of this content is coming back to a public URL. Steven chose 410 Gone over a 301: there is no topically honest destination for 12 articles, and a mass redirect onto /services is the pattern search engines collapse into soft-404s. NOTE the site is a static export (next.config output: 'export'), which cannot emit a status for a path it does not build - these 404 unless a 410 rule is added at the hosting layer for exactly these paths.
